config.minFiles.description: Changes with fewer files open in the standard diff without a tour.
config.cliPath.description: Path to the tour executable. Empty = the CLI bundled with the extension, then `tour` on PATH. The official diff-tour CLI does not work (no --json mode).
config.claudePath.description: Full path to the Claude Code executable (run `which claude` in a terminal). Empty = PATH, then ~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local and your login shell.
config.baseBranch.description: Empty = auto: origin/HEAD, then main, then master.
